items.headline: Hawaii visits UTEP in MWC action
items.description: Hawaii (2-6) at UTEP (1-7), Nov. 7 at 9:30 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Longtime football coach June Jones, pioneer of run-and-shoot offense, dies at 73
items.description: Longtime college and pro football coach June Jones, who helped popularize the run-and-shoot offense, has died at 73.

items.headline: Alejado, Rice help Hawaii go the distance in 56-21 victory over Northern Illinois
items.description: — Micah Alejado threw three touchdown passes, DeVon Rice ran for three scores and Hawaii rolled past Northern Illinois 56-21 on Saturday in a cross-continent matchup.

items.headline: Can Week 8 up the ante again with more upsets and drama?
items.description: With plenty of SEC drama last week, could Week 8 bring even more chaos?

items.headline: Hawaii visits Northern Illinois in MWC action
items.description: Hawaii (1-6) at Northern Illinois (0-6), Oct. 24 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: New Mexico rides Fa'Avae', Humphrey in Lobos' 21-10 win over Hawaii
items.description: — Toa Fa'Avae's 21-yard touchdown run with 6:57 left served as the go-ahead score and New Mexico came back from a first-half deficit to beat Hawaii 21-10 on Saturday.
